items.text: Kosodi kanen ketwana Yosua, kiŋitata idwe luka Isirael EJAKAIT ebe, “Iŋai bo kiŋarenikini sio alosit asurokin Ikanaanin, aitiji kes?”
Kotema EJAKAIT atiar, “Yuda ŋes elosi: koany, ejaik akwap akanike.”
Kotema Yuda onaeeke Simeon atiar, “Bia kauparos oroet lokabeit eoŋ, tetere kitijie Ikanaanin; kwape kwaŋin da kiupar eoŋ kajo oroet lokibeit ijo,” Kouparos Simeon kaŋes.
Kolot Yuda; kijaik EJAKAIT Ikanaanin ka Iperisin akanikee: kodanyata ituŋa ilukumin itomon kaŋul koBesek.
Apotu kodumakis Adoni-besek Besek: kitijioto ŋes, kodanyata Ikanaanin ka Iperisin.
Konye koker Adoni-besek; kodapata ŋes, kikamut ŋes, kotubosi ibokoro lukapolok luka akaninike ka luka akejeke da.

Kotema Adonibesek atiar, “Apotu ikabakan akaisakanykaarei luatuboritai ibokoro lukapolok luka akaninikee ka luka akejekee kirarata ikeeenyamat kokwap kemesaka: kwape abu eoŋ keswamaa, keswamaki Edeke eoŋ kwaŋin.” Koyaŋaarai ŋes Yerusalem, kotwanik ŋina.
Kitijioto idwe luka Yuda Yerusalem, kirumata ŋes, kodanyata lukanen kakwanis naka ekileŋ, kicweata ere.
Kokau kaŋun, koloto idwe luka Yuda aitiji Ikanaanin lueboiete kakwap nakiukon, kari da naka Eŋalakimak, kapuuton da.
Kolot Yuda asurokin Ikanaanin lueboiete koKeburon: (kerai ekiror loka Keburon sek Kiriat-araba:) kodanyata Sesai, ka Akiman, ka Talumai.
Konyoutu kanen koloto asurokin lueboiete koDebir. (Kerai ekiror loka Debir sek Kiriat-seper.)
Kotema Kaleb atiar, “Ŋol loedanyi luka Kiriat-seper, kosodi airum ere, akorakini eoŋ ŋol akokuka Akisa aimany,”
Kirum Otiniel ŋes, loarai okoku loka Kenas, onaee lodidi loka Kaleb: kokorak ŋes Akisa akokuke aimany.
Kosodi kanen, kebu mamake abu ŋin kokoto ŋol ailipun papake emanikor: kodok kasigiriake, kotema Kaleb ŋes atiar, “Inyo bo ikoto ijo?”
Kotema ŋes atiar, “Koinakinai eoŋ arereŋ; naarai kiinakinit eoŋ akwap naka ari naka Eŋalakimak, koinakinai eoŋ da atanin nuka akipi.” Koinak Kaleb ŋes atanin nukokuju ka nukajesa da.
Koloto idwe luka Ekenit, ekamuran loka Musa, anyoun kore loka idukudukun kidwe luka Yuda amodiŋ naka Yuda, naejai eŋalakimak naka Arad; kolototo kiboioto kituŋa.
Koloto Yuda ka onaeeke Simeon, kodanyata Ikanaanin lueboiete koSepat, komudiasi cut. Komaikinai ere Koruma.
Kirum Yuda Gasa da ka eikoruke, ka Asukelon ka eikoruke, ka Ekuron ka eikoruke.
Kojai EJAKAIT kaYuda; kireŋea lueboienenete kakwap nakiukon; naarai mam ŋes abu kopedo aireŋear lueboienenete kaditot, naarai ajaas ŋul agalin nuka asua.
Koinakis Kaleb Keburon kwape abalar Musa: kireŋea kanen odwe luuni luka Anak.
Mam idwe luka Benyamin apotu kireŋcasi Iyebusin lueboiete koYerusalem; konye kiboioto Iyebusin kidwe luka Benyamin koYerusalem, kiton lolo.
Kolot ekalloka Yosep da asurokin Bet-el: kojai EJAKAIT kakes.
Kijuka ekalloka Yosep ituŋa airot Bet-el. (Kerai ekiror loka akwap sek Lus.)
Koanyut ikarotak etuŋanan elomuni kore, kotemasi ŋes atiar, “Kiŋaiŋait, kitodikinai isio neelomarere ore, kiswamakini isio jo nukasianut.”
Abu Idtodik kes neelomarere ore, kodanyata lukorc kakwanis naka ekileŋ; konye apotu koosikis etuŋanan ŋol ka ekekike kere alosit.
Kolot etuŋanan ŋol akwap naka Ikitin, koduk ere, komaik ekekiror Lus: loerai ekekiror kiton lolo.

Mam Manase abu kirenea lueboiete koBet-sean ka ireriake, karaida luka Taanak ka ireriake, karaida lueboiete koDor ka ireriake, karaida lueboiete koIbuleam ka ireriake, karaida lueboiete koMegido ka ireriake: konye apotu Ikanaanin kiboioto kakwap kaŋin,
Kosodi kanen, kegogoŋor Isirael, apotu kitaraut Ikanaanin ikeswamak nakailolitoi, mam apotu kireŋeasi kes eut,
Mam Epuraim abu kirenea Ikanaanin lueboiete koGesir; konye kiboioto Ikanaanin koGeser kamakec.
Mam Sebulun abu kirenea lueboiete koKitiron, karaida lueboiete koNakalol; konye apotu Ikanaanin kiboioto kamakec, koraut ikeswamak nukailolitoi.
Mam Aser abu kirenea lueboiete koAko, karaida lueboiete koSidon, karaida luka Akulab, karaida luka Akisib, karaida luka Keluba, karaida luka Apik, karaida luka Rekob:
Konye apotu Iserain kiboioto kama ejaas Ikanaanin ikulepek akwap: naarai mam apotu kireneasi kes.

Mam Naputali abu kirenea lueboiete koBet-semes, karaida lueboiete koBet-anat; konye kiboi kama ejaas Ikanaanin, ikulepek akwap: konye apotu lueboiete koBet-semes ka luka Bet-anak koraut ikeswamakakec nukailolitoi.
Apotu Imorain koremosi idwe luka Dan akwap nakiukon: naarai mam apotu koeamakis kes abunore aditot:
Konye kiboikinos Imorain moru Keres, ka Aiyalon ka Saalubim: konye kolanir akan naka ekal loka Yosep, kwaŋin koraunos ikeswamak nukailolitoi.
Ageunit eikor loka Imorain kaneedokarere Akurabim, anyoun komoru, kiton kuju.
